items.title: Neon Tide
items.short_synopsis: A salvage diver finds a city of light beneath the harbour — and someone who wants it to stay hidden.

items.title: Kingdom of Ash
items.short_synopsis: Heirs to a burning throne fight to rebuild a kingdom — and each other.

items.title: Paper Kings
items.short_synopsis: Two rival street vendors accidentally become the most powerful newspaper barons in town.

items.title: Quiet Harbour
items.short_synopsis: Every summer, a ferry captain and a lighthouse painter meet on the same crossing — for ten years.

items.title: The Rain
items.short_synopsis: After a storm that never ends, a ferry pilot and her brother cross a drowned coastline to find the one town where the rain has stopped.
